findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet
Tinypool: Prototype Pollution gadget in worker options leads to Remote Code Execution
Tinypool: Prototype Pollution Gadget to RCE in run() options
zip: legacy Shrink/Reduce/Implode decoder: denial of service from attacker-controlled ZIP64 uncompressed size
zip: Arbitrary file write outside the extraction directory, because ZipArchive::extract validates symlink targets lexically.

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction

compression vulnerable to Denial of Service via memory leak on premature response close
launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows

nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero

evidence: the project's source does not use customAlphabet, customRandom, but other packages depend on nanoid
